data.name: Combat Mission 2: Barbarossa to Berlin
data.detailed_description:
Combat Mission 2: Barbarossa to Berlin classic game from 2002 ventures into the heart of World War Il wargaming: the Eastern Front. The struggle between Nazi Germany and the Soviet Union captures the flavor of the four years of conflict that left Germany in ruins. Combat Mission 2 includes over 125 battles between 1941 and the final capitulation in May 1945, and many more are possible with the full-featured editor.

You are the commander of breathtaking battles set in Moscow, Stalingrad, Berlin and many more well-known battlefields. Combat Mission: Barbarossa to Berlin involves a variety of units and tactical possibilities - prepare for war on the Eastern Front!

  • Historically correct turn-based strategy game

  • Unique fighting system: a combination of real-time and turn-based strategy

  • More than 300 vehicle and 600 infantry types modeled

  • High res 3D graphics with varied weather conditions, seasons and times of day

  • 7 nations: Germany, Russia, Finland, Hungary, Romania, Poland and Italy

  • Over 50 of the best-rated new scenarios (over 125 scenarios in total)

  • User-friendly Battle and Map Editor with dozens of settings and terrain types unconditional surrender of Germany

  • Entire Eastern Front depicted from 1941 to 1945: from Operation Barbarossa to the

  • Over 200 mods

data.short_description: Command epic WWII battles on the Eastern Front in Combat Mission 2: Barbarossa to Berlin. Fight from Moscow to Berlin across 125+ scenarios, or create your own with the editor. Experience tactical warfare at its most intense!
